evals.prompt: Write one Seedream woodblock poster prompt for a fictional clockwork gardener in a glasshouse: round metal head, compact torso, exactly two articulated arms with fingered hands and two supporting legs. Use engraved red, jade and printed gold ink on aged paper. No references and no generation.
evals.expected_output: One text-only prompt preserving the supplied anatomy and glasshouse, flat print treatment, readable silhouette and anatomy checklist, with no invented image binding or cultural setting.

evals.prompt: Write three separate woodblock art poster prompts for a fox, owl and whale. No reference images. Use cobalt, cream and rust on clean paper, borderless. Keep the series cohesive but vary silhouettes and landscapes. Do not generate images.
evals.expected_output: Three self-contained text-only prompts with matching print style, borderless framing, distinct subjects and no invented references.

evals.prompt: Write one poster prompt for my fictional masked traveler. Image 1 should supply identity and silhouette; image 2 should supply only print texture and palette. I forgot to attach both images and have no further visual description. Preserve the existing design exactly. I need the exact slogan JOURNEYS AHEAD at the bottom. No generation.
evals.expected_output: Requests the missing images, records intended ordered identity/style roles without claiming inspection or inventing visible details or usable bindings, leaves exact matching unresolved, and reserves exact slogan text for deterministic finishing.
